body:
A CHEBI-grounding pass over MIM's ungrounded ingredients (CAS→CHEBI via the local ChEBI dbxref index, complex-ingredient resolver, non-chemical flagging), relying on MIM's curated data + kg-microbe. **Finding: MIM is already well-curated** — of ~2,206 ungrounded unified rows, the substantive results were a handful of corrections, not a mass grounding.

## Landed (reviewed clean by Fable 5)
- **PR #112** — CHEBI grounding + curation:
  - Gepotidacin `cas:1075236-89-3` → `CHEBI:747127` (skos:exactMatch; unique CAS dbxref + label-exact).
  - Glycogen from bovine liver: `cas:` FALLBACK → `CHEBI:28087` (glycogen), exactMatch (source qualifier).
  - Beef extract: removed erroneous `cas_rn 103-47-9` (that CAS is CHES / `CHEBI:44302` — a PubChem name-lookup false positive); stays on `FOODON:03302088`.
  - SSSOM reconciled in-sync; invariants A/B1/B2/B3 pass.
- **PR #113** — periodic `UNIFIED_INGREDIENT_MAPPING.tsv` refresh (3,853→3,937 rows, CHEBI 1,647→1,668). Reviewer confirmed 100% CHEBI internal consistency.

## Already-correct (curation queue items that needed no change)
- sn-glycerol-3-phosphate lithium salt → `CHEBI:15978` (NARROW_MATCH, matches sibling salts).
- carnitine-DL-HCl → `CHEBI:17126` (carnitine, stereo-unspecified parent — correct for a DL racemate).

## Open follow-ups
- [ ] **Audit PubChem-sourced `cas_rn` for other false-positives.** Beef extract's `103-47-9` (=CHES) was a name-lookup mis-assignment by `fetch_cas_rn_from_pubchem`. Cross-check `chemical_properties.cas_rn` (esp. on `UNDEFINED_MIXTURE`/complex records) against CHEBI/expected formula to catch other bad CAS.
- [ ] **45 flagged non-chemicals** need disposition (not CHEBI-groundable): ~10 placeholders ("See source for composition"), ~20 complex mixtures/solutions, ~7 environmental/media, ~8 buffers (borderline). Decide: leave UNMAPPED, map to FOODON/ENVO, or mark NON_CHEMICAL.
- [ ] **Complex-resolver NO_HIT peptones** (Peptone, Proteose peptone, Trypticase peptone, …) would map cleanly to **MICRO** (`MICRO:0000178` = peptone) — deferred; needs the `MICRO:` prefix added to the SSSOM curie_map + builder.
- [ ] **Possible pre-existing mis-mapping:** `Carnitine Hydrochloride` → `CHEBI:48601` "carnitinamide chloride" — carnitinamide is the amide (a different compound); a curator should confirm vs carnitine/carnitinium chloride.

Full pipeline report (per-tier counts, all candidates) is captured in PR #112's description. Spec + report live in the session scratchpad (`GROUNDING_SPEC.md`, `chebi_grounding_report.md`).

comments.body: Follow-ups addressed in https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/pull/115: cholesterol/glycerol/Sulfur/Carnitine CAS-mapping corrections (all verified vs ChEBI); 4 residual peptones mapped (MICRO already integrated — that item was stale); 2 true placeholders flagged. **Re-scoped Task 2:** the non-chemical set is ~130 (not 45), dominated by ~107 commercial media names → tracked as a separate 'media vs ingredient' modeling task. **New:** Carnitine Hydrochloride ↔ Carnitine (Dl) Hydrochloride likely duplicate — needs curator dedup.

Remaining follow-ups worked in https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/pull/116: (1) media modeling — reclassified 53 commercial media UNDEFINED_MIXTURE→DEFINED_MEDIUM (schema already had the type; no change needed); (2) Carnitine Hydrochloride dedup — decided NOT a duplicate (distinct surface-form, both →CHEBI:17126), documented; (3) cosmetic peptone history prose fixed. No mappings changed; gates pass.

## All four open follow-ups addressed — merged as #289

**UNMAPPED 378 → 312.** Records that actually occur in media: **108 → 45**.

### 1. Audit PubChem-sourced `cas_rn` — done

Cross-checked every record carrying **both** a `cas_rn` and a CHEBI term with a CAS dbxref: **1214 records, 1068 agree, 146 disagree**. Classifying the 146 is the finding — only **6 are defects**:

| class | n | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| salt / hydrate forms | 71 | expected — CAS describes the record, term is the parent (#218/#242) |
| stereochemistry | 57 | expected — L-form CAS on a stereo-unspecified parent |
| spelling variants | 12 | expected |
| **not a CAS at all** | **6** | **fixed** |

The six were **EC/EINECS** numbers (`NNN-NNN-N`); **five carried `data_source: PubChem API`**, the same path that produced Beef extract's `103-47-9` (=CHES). Fixed from each record's own ChEBI dbxref — evidence, not inference, since every term label matched the substance.

Filed **#287**: `cas_rn` has no schema pattern so a re-import can reintroduce them. Note there that a *semantic* cross-check would be ~96% false positives, so only format validation is worth gating on.

### 2. 45 flagged non-chemicals — dispositioned

The population turned out to be dominated by **96 UNMAPPED `STOCK_SOLUTION` records**. Searching CHEBI/NCIT/MeSH/FOODON/ENVO across all 96 found hits for **2, both false** — `PBS` → *'TSPO wt Allele'* (a gene allele) and `Trace minerals` → an M-prefixed MeSH concept id.

- **61 minted** `kgmicrobe.ingredient:` (every one that occurs in a medium), following the convention 12 mapped records already used;
- **MES / PIPES / MOPS buffers** → mints **with a narrowMatch** to their compound (single-compound solutions do have a parent);
- **`Rumen fluid`** → `UBERON:0010228`, the generic term — per this issue's sibling #204, `MICRO:0000520` *clarified* rumen fluid names a **processed** form;
- **`Sea salts`** → `NCIT:C75874`.

Rejected `TAPSO` → `MESH:C047133` (*dermorphin*, a peptide). Left UNMAPPED: multi-component buffers and the marine/soilwater **media** — correct outcomes per the guardrails. **#288** tracks the 35 zero-occurrence stock solutions left unminted.

### 3. Peptones → MICRO — already done

All eight (`Peptone`, `Proteose Peptone`, `Trypticase peptone`, `Tryptone`, `Casitone`, …) already hold MICRO terms at EXACT_MATCH. Worth recording that the 0-byte MICRO build does **not** block this: MICRO sits in the id-label validator's `ignored_prefixes`, so it skips rather than fails.

### 4. Carnitine Hydrochloride — already resolved

Corrected by `cbclaw_followups_114` in July; the record holds `kgmicrobe.compound:carnitine_hydrochloride` with a narrowMatch to `CHEBI:17126`. The `CHEBI:48601` strings that remain are curation-history provenance describing that fix, not a live mapping.

---

Closing this issue: all four follow-ups are either applied or verified already-done, with the residual questions tracked in #287 and #288.

title: CHEBI grounding pass — results, curation report & open follow-ups
